notes: AI Builder capability rate table, AI Builder credit column. Seeded AI Builder credits are removed on 2026-11-01 (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ai-builder/endofaibcredits). Rates are used to invert observed AI Builder credit consumption back into capability units (pages, images, 1K chars, 1K tokens). Capabilities are matched in array order: first match wins, so prebuilt document models must precede the generic custom document processing entry. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions tested against AI model template name, AI model name, event name and the LLM model name from msdyn_eventdata.

capabilities.assumption: Blended rate assumes 90% input / 10% output tokens per Microsoft's published estimate; exact input/output rates are used when the token split is present in msdyn_eventdata. Prompts created before model selection default to the basic model per the credit-management FAQ; events whose LLM model cannot be resolved are therefore rated basic.

capabilities.assumptionTiering: gpt-4.1/gpt-41 (full) and gpt-5-chat assumed STANDARD tier; verify against the AI Builder rate card in the Power Platform Licensing Guide PDF when Microsoft updates it.
